title: Gated pipeline
alt: Six gate stages run in order; a failing stage rejects the change before an Exit-0 receipt is signed.
text: Gate stages: 1. Prefetch & Lockfiles (lockfiles, go mod verify), 2. HISS Invariant Scan (debt-baseline ratchet), 3. Security & SCA Scan (govulncheck, gosec), 4. Flavor Conformance (flavor audit), 5. Race-Detector Tests (go test -race, worktree), 6. Exit-0 Receipt (Ed25519-signed output).
Boxes: Signing key (env var or key file), Candidate commit (praetorctl gate run), .standards-receipt.json (Exit-0 receipt), Rejected (exit 1, stage named).
Candidate commit → 1. Prefetch & Lockfiles (clean tree) → 2. HISS Invariant Scan → 3. Security & SCA Scan → 4. Flavor Conformance → 5. Race-Detector Tests → 6. Exit-0 Receipt.

Scenario 1, clean run: Every stage passes and the receipt is signed. The tree matches HEAD. Lockfiles found; modules verified. No HISS violation beyond the baseline. govulncheck and gosec pass. Flavor conformance holds. Race-detector tests pass. LoadSigningKey returns the Ed25519 key. The stage output is signed for this commit.

Scenario 2, HISS violation: A new violation fails stage 2; no later stage runs. The tree matches HEAD. Stage 1 passes. The ratchet finds a violation beyond the baseline (an incomplete scan fails too); the gate exits 1.

Scenario 3, dry run: gate run --dry-run runs the read-only checks only. The tree may differ from HEAD. Lockfiles checked; module download skipped. The HISS scan runs. Security scan skipped. Flavor conformance runs. Race-detector tests skipped. No receipt is minted.
Scenario 4, no signing key: Stage 6 fails closed without a key. Stages 1 to 5 pass. No PRAETOR_RECEIPT_KEY and no key file: the stage fails and nothing is signed.
Only a failed stage stops the pipeline; a stage that ran nothing is skipped or not_applicable.

Stage failures: 1, a missing or empty manifest or lockfile, or a failed go mod verify or download; 2, debt beyond the baseline, an incomplete scan or an unreadable baseline; 3, a govulncheck or gosec finding, or a missing scanner or .gosec.json; 4, a flavor score below 80% or a missing template; 5, a failing go test -race; 6, no signing key.
